result.instructions: Tools for Detrack, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which deliveries failed today, and why?"; "Show me all jobs assigned to Driver A for 2026-11-27."; "Find the job with tracking number 1Z999 and tell me its current status.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Detrack data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run detrack_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run detrack_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run detrack_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. detrack_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: detrack_list_jobs
tools.title: List jobs
tools.description: List delivery and collection jobs (D.O.s), newest first unless sorted. Filter by date, type, assignee, status or DO number. Detrack API: GET /dn/jobs.

sort.description: Sort field; prefix with - for descending (e.g. -created_at).

assign_to.description: Filter by the driver or team the job is assigned to.

query.description: Free-text search over DO number, address, recipient, tracking number and zone.

tools.name: detrack_get_job
tools.title: Get a job
tools.description: Get one job by its DO number, with its items and milestones. Detrack API: GET /dn/jobs/{do_number}.

do_number.description: D.O. (delivery order) number of the job.

tools.name: detrack_get_job_on_date
tools.title: Get a job on a date
tools.description: Get one job by DO number on a given date. Use this when the same DO number exists on several dates. Detrack API: GET /dn/jobs/{do_number}/{date}.

do_number.description: D.O. (delivery order) number of the job.

annotations.title: Get a job on a date

tools.name: detrack_search_jobs
tools.title: Search jobs
tools.description: Search jobs with several filters at once (date ranges, statuses, reasons, zone, customer, tracking or order numbers). Detrack API: POST /dn/jobs/search.

tools.name: detrack_list_depots
tools.title: List depots
tools.description: List the depots (warehouses or branches) set up on the account. Detrack API: GET /dn/depots.

tools.name: detrack_get_depot
tools.title: Get a depot by name
tools.description: Get one depot by its exact name. Detrack API: GET /dn/depots/?name=.

tools.name: detrack_list_routes
tools.title: List routes for a date
tools.description: List the routes planned for a date, with their jobs when available. Detrack API: GET /dn/routes.

tools.name: detrack_create_job
tools.title: Create a job
tools.description: Create one delivery or collection job (a new D.O.). It does not overwrite an existing DO number on the same date. Detrack API: POST /dn/jobs.

do_number.description: D.O. (delivery order) number of the job.

notify_email.description: Email to notify about the job.

tools.name: detrack_update_job
tools.title: Update a job
tools.description: Update fields of one job by DO number (only the fields you pass change). Completed jobs may refuse the change. Detrack API: PUT /dn/jobs/{do_number}.

do_number.description: D.O. (delivery order) number of the job.

tools.name: detrack_delete_job
tools.title: Delete a job
tools.description: Permanently delete one job, identified by DO number and date, so the right job is removed. Detrack API: DELETE /dn/jobs/{do_number}/{date}.

do_number.description: D.O. (delivery order) number of the job.
